---
title: "Trends"
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
attacks <- read_rds("data/attacks.rds")
```

```{r}
attacks |>
  filter(!is.na(Activity)) |>
  add_count(Activity, name = "activity_total") |>
  filter(activity_total >= 50, Fatal_clean != "Unknown") |>
  count(Activity, Fatal_clean, name = "attacks") |>
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Fatal_clean,
    values_from = attacks,
    values_fill = 0
  )
```
